questions.question: Paudhay khana banane ke liye hawa se kaunsi gas jazb (absorb) karte hain?
questions.explanation: Paudhay photosynthesis ke zariye carbon dioxide, sunlight aur pani ka istemal karke glucose banate hain.
questions.hint: Sochiye insan saans lete waqt kya bahar chhorte hain.

questions.question: Paani ka chemical symbol kya hai?
questions.explanation: Paani do hydrogen atoms aur ek oxygen atom se milkar banta hai.
questions.hint: Is mein do tarah ke atoms shamil hain.

questions.question: Insani jism mein khoon ko pump kaunsa organ karta hai?
questions.explanation: Dil ek pathon wala pump hai jo khoon ko poore jism mein gardish karta hai.
questions.hint: Yeh taqreeban har second mein dhadakta hai.

questions.question: Cell ka 'powerhouse' kise kaha jata hai?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria respiration ke zariye cell ke liye zyada tar ATP energy banata hai.
questions.hint: Yeh energy paida karne ke liye mashhoor hai.

questions.question: Atomic number 1 kis element ka hai?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen mein ek proton hota hai, is liye iska atomic number 1 hai aur yeh sabse halka element hai.
questions.hint: Yeh kainaat ka sabse halka aur sabse zyada paya jane wala element hai.

questions.question: Kaunsa bond do atoms ke darmiyan electrons share karne se banta hai?
questions.explanation: Covalent bond tab banta hai jab do atoms ek ya zyada electron pairs share karte hain.
questions.hint: 'Co-' ka matlab hota hai milkar kaam karna.

questions.question: Kaunsa subatomic particle koi electric charge nahi rakhta?
questions.explanation: Neutron ek electrically neutral particle hai jo atom ke nucleus mein proton ke saath paya jata hai.
questions.hint: Iska naam 'neutral' se milta julta hai.

questions.question: DNA replication ke dauran DNA ko unwind karne wala enzyme kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Helicase double helix ko unwind karta hai, base pairs ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds tor kar.
questions.hint: Iska naam 'helix' se aata hai.

questions.question: Kaunsa law kehta hai ke energy na banayi ja sakti hai na khatam ki ja sakti hai?
questions.explanation: Thermodynamics ka pehla law kehta hai ke isolated system mein total energy hamesha constant rehti hai.
questions.hint: Yeh thermodynamics ka ek buniyadi usool hai.

questions.question: Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle bunyadi taur par kis baare mein hai?
options: Position aur momentum ki ek sath sahih maloomat
questions.explanation: Yeh kehta hai ke aap ek particle ki exact position aur momentum ko ek sath poori sahih se nahi jaan sakte.
questions.hint: Yeh quantum mechanics ka ek buniyadi usool hai.

questions.question: Electromagnetic force ke liye force carrier particle kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Photons charged particles ke darmiyan electromagnetic force ko carry karte hain.
questions.hint: Yeh roshni ka bhi particle hai.

questions.question: Krebs cycle bunyadi taur par cell ke liye kya paida karta hai?
questions.explanation: Krebs cycle NADH aur FADH2 banata hai, jo electron transport chain ko ATP banane ke liye fuel deta hai.
questions.hint: Yeh mitochondria ke andar hota hai.

questions.question: Rakbay ke lihaz se sabse bara continent kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Asia zameen ke taqreeban 30% hisse par mushtamil hai, jo isay sabse bara continent banata hai.
questions.hint: Yahan duniya ki aadhi se zyada aabadi rehti hai.

questions.question: Duniya ka sabse lamba darya kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Nile, jo north-eastern Africa se guzarta hai, aam taur par sabse lamba darya mana jata hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Egypt se guzarta hai.

questions.question: France ka darul hakoomat (capital) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Paris sadiyon se France ka capital raha hai aur iska sabse bara shehar bhi hai.
questions.hint: Yahan Eiffel Tower waqay hai.

questions.question: Duniya ka sabse bara garam sehra (desert) kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Sahara North Africa ke bare hisse tak phaila hua hai aur yeh duniya ka sabse bara garam sehra hai.
questions.hint: Yeh zyada tar North Africa ko cover karta hai.

questions.question: Mount Kilimanjaro kis mulk mein waqay hai?
questions.explanation: Kilimanjaro, jo Africa ki sabse buland choti hai, north-eastern Tanzania mein waqay hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Africa ka sabse buland pahar hai.

questions.question: Kis mulk mein sabse zyada time zones hain?
questions.explanation: France ke paas apne bahar-e-mulk (overseas) ilaqon ki wajah se 12 time zones hain.
questions.hint: Sirf mainland nahi balke bahar-e-mulk ilaqon ke baray mein bhi sochiye.

questions.question: Sabse tang jagah par Europe ko Africa se kaunsi strait alag karti hai?
questions.explanation: Strait of Gibraltar sabse tang jagah par Spain ko Morocco se alag karti hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Atlantic Ocean ko Mediterranean Sea se jorti hai.

questions.question: Rakbay ke lihaz se duniya ka sabse chota mulk kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Vatican City, taqreeban 0.49 square kilometers ke sath, sabse chota sovereign state hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Rome, Italy ke andar ek enclave hai.

questions.question: Lake Baikal, duniya ki sabse gehri jheel, kis mulk mein waqay hai?
questions.explanation: Siberia, Russia mein waqay Lake Baikal duniya ki sabse gehri aur sabse purani freshwater jheel hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Siberia mein hai.

questions.question: Duniya ki sabse lambi zameeni sarhad (border) kis do mulkon ke darmiyan hai?
questions.explanation: USA-Canada border 8,800 km se zyada lamba hai, jo duniya mein sabse lamba hai.
questions.hint: In mein se ek mulk North America mein hai.

questions.question: Danakil Depression, duniya ki sabse garam jaghon mein se ek, kis mulk mein waqay hai?
questions.explanation: Danakil Depression north-eastern Ethiopia ke Afar region mein waqay hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Horn of Africa mein hai.

questions.question: Coordinated Universal Time ke liye reference kaunsa meridian istemal hota hai?
questions.explanation: Prime Meridian, jo Greenwich, England se guzarti hai, 0° longitude aur time ka reference hai.
questions.hint: Yeh London ke ek borough se guzarti hai.

questions.question: World War II kis saal khatam hui?
questions.explanation: World War II 1945 mein Germany aur phir Japan ki shikast ke sath khatam hui.
questions.hint: Yeh 2025 se theek 80 saal pehle hai.

questions.question: United States ke pehle president kaun thay?
questions.explanation: George Washington 1789 se 1797 tak pehle US President rahe.
questions.hint: Unki tasveer ek dollar ke note par hai.

questions.question: Giza ke pyramids kis qadeem tehzeeb ne banaye?
questions.explanation: Egyptians ne Giza pyramids apne pharaohs ke maqbaron (tombs) ke taur par banaye.
questions.hint: Nile darya ke baray mein sochiye.

questions.question: Berlin Wall kis saal girri?
questions.explanation: Berlin Wall November 1989 mein giri, jo Cold War ki taqseem ke khatme ki alamat thi.
questions.hint: Yeh Soviet Union ke khatme se thora pehle ki baat hai.

questions.question: Declaration of Independence kisne likha?
questions.explanation: Thomas Jefferson US Declaration of Independence ke asal musannif (author) thay.
questions.hint: Baad mein woh teesray US President bane.

questions.question: Renaissance ka aghaz kis mulk mein hua?
questions.explanation: Renaissance ka aghaz 14vi century mein Italy mein hua, jiska markaz Florence jaise shehar thay.
questions.hint: Florence aur Medici family ke baray mein sochiye.

questions.question: World War I ko rasmi taur par kaunsi treaty ne khatam kiya?
questions.explanation: 1919 mein dastakhat honay wali Treaty of Versailles ne World War I ko rasmi taur par khatam kiya.
questions.hint: Yeh ek mashhoor French palace mein dastakhat hui thi.

questions.question: Cuban Missile Crisis ke dauran Soviet Union ka rehnuma kaun tha?
questions.explanation: Nikita Khrushchev ne 1962 ke Cuban Missile Crisis ke dauran USSR ki rehnumai ki.
questions.hint: Woh UN mein apna joota maar kar bhi mashhoor huay.

questions.question: Magna Carta kis saal dastakhat hui?
questions.explanation: England ke King John ne 1215 mein Magna Carta par dastakhat kiye, jisse shahi ikhtiyar mehdood hua.
questions.hint: Yeh 13vi century ke shuru mein hai.

questions.question: Suleiman the Magnificent ne kaunsi saltanat par hukumat ki?
questions.explanation: Suleiman the Magnificent ne Ottoman Empire par uski territorial aur cultural iqbal-mandi ke daur mein hukumat ki.
questions.hint: Yeh saltanat aaj kal ke Turkey mein markooz thi.

questions.question: 1648 ki Peace of Westphalia sab se zyada kis jang ke khatme se mansoob hai?
questions.explanation: Peace of Westphalia ne Thirty Years' War ko khatam kiya aur European sovereignty ko dobara tashkeel diya.
questions.hint: Is jang ka naam iski muddat se milta hai.

questions.question: Russia ke aakhri Tsar kaun thay?
questions.explanation: Nicholas II aakhri Tsar thay, jinhon ne 1917 mein Russian Revolution ke dauran taj chhora.
questions.hint: 1917 ke inqilab mein unhein takht se hataya gaya.

questions.question: Kaunsa sayara 'Red Planet' ke naam se jana jata hai?
questions.explanation: Mars ki satah par iron oxide (zang) ki wajah se yeh surkh nazar aata hai.
questions.hint: Iska rang iron oxide se aata hai.

questions.question: Zameen ke sabse qareeb sitara kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Suraj zameen ke sabse qareeb sitara hai, taqreeban 150 million km door.
questions.hint: Aap isay har roz dekh sakte hain.

questions.question: Hamare solar system mein kitne sayare hain?
questions.explanation: 2006 mein Pluto ko dwarf planet qarar diye jane ke baad se 8 rasmi sayare hain.
questions.hint: Pluto ab shumar nahi hota.

questions.question: Hamara solar system jis galaxy mein hai uska naam kya hai?
questions.explanation: Hamara solar system Milky Way mein hai, jo ek barred spiral galaxy hai.
questions.hint: Iska naam ek chocolate bar se milta julta hai.

questions.question: Halia surveys ke mutabiq kis sayare ke paas sabse zyada tasdeeq shuda (confirmed) chaand hain?
questions.explanation: Halia astronomical surveys mein Saturn ne confirmed moons ki tadad mein Jupiter ko peechay chor diya hai.
questions.hint: Us sayare ke baray mein sochiye jo apne rings ki wajah se mashhoor hai.

questions.question: Sayaron ko Suraj ke gird orbit mein kaunsi force rakhti hai?
questions.explanation: Suraj ki mass se paida honay wali gravity sayaron ko unki orbits mein bandhay rakhti hai.
questions.hint: Yeh wohi force hai jo aapko zameen ki taraf khaenchti hai.

questions.question: Light-year kis cheez ka paimana (measurement) hai?
questions.explanation: Light-year woh fasla hai jo roshni ek saal mein tay karti hai, taqreeban 9.46 trillion km.
questions.hint: Naam ke bawajood, yeh waqt ki wahid nahi hai.

questions.question: Kaunsa spacecraft pehli baar insanon ko chaand par lekar gaya?
questions.explanation: Apollo 11 ne July 1969 mein Neil Armstrong aur Buzz Aldrin ko chaand par utara.
questions.hint: Yeh sab se mashhoor Apollo mission hai.

questions.question: Black hole ke gird us hadd ka naam kya hai jiske baad kuch bhi bach nahi sakta?
questions.explanation: Event horizon black hole ke gird woh point hai jahan se wapsi mumkin nahi.
questions.hint: Isse paar karne ke baad wapsi nahi hoti.

questions.question: Kaunsi cheez pulsar ko munazzam (regular) radiation ke pulses kharij karne par majboor karti hai?
options: Tez ghumaav ke sath beamed radiation
questions.explanation: Pulsars ghoomtay huay neutron stars hain jinki beamed radiation lighthouse ki tarah zameen ke qareeb se guzarti hai.
questions.hint: Ek lighthouse ki roshni ke baray mein sochiye.

questions.question: 2015 mein Pluto ki pehli qareebi tasveerein kis mission ne farahim kin?
questions.explanation: NASA ka New Horizons probe July 2015 mein Pluto ke paas se guzra aur pehli tafseeli tasveerein li.
questions.hint: Iska naam naye ilaqon ki talash ka pata deta hai.

questions.question: Black hole ke markaz mein infinite density ke nazriyati (theoretical) point ko kya kehte hain?
questions.explanation: Singularity woh point hai jahan black hole ki mass ko infinitely dense mana jata hai.
questions.hint: Yahan maloom physics kaam karna chhor deti hai.

questions.question: Shehad ki makhiyan (bees) phoolon se bunyadi taur par kya jama karti hain?
questions.explanation: Bees phoolon se nectar jama karti hain aur ise hive mein shehad mein tabdeel karti hain.
questions.hint: Yeh phoolon ke andar ka meetha mayya hai.

questions.question: Kis janwar ko 'King of the Jungle' kaha jata hai?
questions.explanation: Lion ko roaytati taur par King of the Jungle kaha jata hai, hala ke yeh zyada tar grasslands mein rehta hai.
questions.hint: Iski gardan ke gird ek khaas ayaal (mane) hoti hai.

questions.question: Sabse lamba zameeni janwar kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Giraffe, apni lambi gardan aur taango ki wajah se, sabse lamba zinda zameeni janwar hai.
questions.hint: Iski gardan mashhoor taur par bohat lambi hoti hai.

questions.question: Paudhay sunlight ko energy mein tabdeel karne ke liye kaunsa amal (process) istemal karte hain?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis sunlight, pani aur CO2 ko glucose aur oxygen mein tabdeel karta hai.
questions.hint: Is lafz mein 'photo' shamil hai, jiska matlab hai roshni.

questions.question: Shark ki sabse bari qisam kaunsi hai?
questions.explanation: Whale shark, jo filter feeder hai, aaj ki sabse bari machli (fish) hai.
questions.hint: Apne saiz ke bawajood, yeh nihayat naram-mizaj hai aur plankton khati hai.

questions.question: Janwar respiration ke zaya mahsulaat (byproduct) ke taur par kaunsi gas khaarij karte hain?
questions.explanation: Janwar carbon dioxide khaarij karte hain, jo cellular respiration ki zaya paidawar hai.
questions.hint: Paudhay is gas ko jazb karte hain.

questions.question: Sheron ke jhund (group) ko kya kaha jata hai?
questions.explanation: Sheron ke jhund ko 'pride' kaha jata hai, jo aam taur par milti julti maadain (females) aur unke bachon par mushtamil hota hai.
questions.hint: Yeh lafz khud-ehtaram (self-respect) ke liye bhi istemal hota hai.

questions.question: Kaunsa biome hamesha jamay hue zameen (permafrost) aur bohat kam darakhton se mumtaz hai?
questions.explanation: Tundra mein hamesha jami hui zamin (permafrost) hoti hai aur darakht bohat kam hote hain.
questions.hint: Arctic ilaqon ke baray mein sochiye.

questions.question: Sundi (caterpillar) ka titli (butterfly) banne ke amal ko kya kehte hain?
questions.explanation: Metamorphosis ek biological amal hai jo titli jaise kiron mein tabdeeli ki soorat mein nazar aata hai.
questions.hint: Is lafz ka matlab hai 'shakal ki tabdeeli'.

questions.question: Kaunsa symbiotic taluq dono organisms ko faida deta hai?
questions.explanation: Mutualism woh taluq hai jahan dono species ko faida hota hai, jaise bees aur phool-daar paudhay.
questions.hint: Is lafz mein 'mutual' shamil hai.

questions.question: Un janwaron ko kya kaha jata hai jo raat ke waqt zyada faal (active) hote hain?
questions.explanation: Nocturnal janwar, jaise ulloo aur chamgadar, bunyadi taur par raat ko faal hote hain.
questions.hint: 'Noct-' lafz raat se mutalliq hai.

questions.question: Kis keystone species ki dobara aabadkari (reintroduction) ne Yellowstone mein daryaon ka rukh badal diya, jo bohat mashhoor hai?
questions.explanation: Dobara aabad kiye gaye bhediyon ne elk ke charne ke tareeqay badal diye, jisse vegetation aur daryaon ke kinaray sthir huay.
questions.hint: Yeh shikari 1990s mein dobara laya gaya tha.

questions.question: Leap year mein kitne din hote hain?
questions.explanation: Leap year mein 366 din hote hain, February mein aik extra din shamil karke.
questions.hint: Yeh aam saal se aik zyada hai.

questions.question: Standard atmospheric pressure par pani ka freezing point Celsius mein kya hai?
questions.explanation: Pani 0 degree Celsius par jamta hai.
questions.hint: Yeh woh number hai jahan se Celsius scale shuru hoti hai.

questions.question: Kis shakal ke teen taraf (sides) hotay hain?
questions.explanation: Triangle ek polygon hai jiske theek teen sides aur teen angles hotay hain.
questions.hint: 'Tri-' prefix ka matlab teen hota hai.

questions.question: Aik standard guitar mein kitni strings hoti hain?
questions.explanation: Standard guitar mein cheh (6) strings hoti hain, jo E-A-D-G-B-E par tune hoti hain.
questions.hint: Yeh aik juft (even) number hai.

questions.question: Japan mein kaunsi currency istemal hoti hai?
questions.explanation: Japan ki sarkari currency Yen hai, jo ¥ se zahir hoti hai.
questions.hint: Yeh mulk ke pehle vowel sound wale harf se shuru hoti hai.

questions.question: Mona Lisa kisne banayi (paint ki)?
questions.explanation: Leonardo da Vinci ne 16vi century ke shuru mein Mona Lisa banayi.
questions.hint: Woh aik mashhoor inventor aur scientist bhi thay.

questions.question: 'HTTP' ka matlab kya hai?
questions.explanation: HTTP ka matlab HyperText Transfer Protocol hai, jo web par data communication ki buniyad hai.
questions.hint: Yeh zyada tar web addresses ke peechay ka protocol hai.

questions.question: Pehla iPhone kis saal release hua?
questions.explanation: Apple ne June 2007 mein pehla iPhone release kiya.
questions.hint: Yeh Macworld mein Steve Jobs ne announce kiya tha.

questions.question: Samandar ki satah se sabse buland pahar kaunsa hai?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest, 8,849 meters ke sath, samandar ki satah se sabse buland pahar hai.
questions.hint: Yeh Nepal aur Tibet ki sarhad par waqay hai.

questions.question: Europe mein movable type printing press kis mulk ne ijaad ki?
questions.explanation: Johannes Gutenberg ne taqreeban 1440 mein Germany mein movable-type printing press ijaad ki.
questions.hint: Is inventor ka surname publishing history mein mashhoor hai.

questions.question: Us lafz ko kya kehte hain jo aagay aur peechay dono taraf se ek jaisa parha jata hai?
questions.explanation: Palindrome, jaise 'level' ya 'radar', dono taraf se ek jaisa parha jata hai.
questions.hint: 'Racecar' iski aik klasik misal hai.

questions.question: Kaunsi beynulaqwami idara Greenwich par mabni global time ka standard barqarar rakhti hai?
options: International Bureau of Weights and Measures (BIPM)
questions.explanation: BIPM duniya bhar ki atomic clocks ka istemal karke Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) ko coordinate karta hai.
questions.hint: Yeh aik metrology idara hai, UN ka hissa nahi.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 2, 4, 6, 8, ?
questions.explanation: Har number 2 se barhta hai, is liye 8 ke baad agla number 10 hai.
questions.hint: Dekhiye har number kitna barhta hai.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 5, 10, 15, 20, ?
questions.explanation: Har number 5 se barhta hai, is liye sequence 25 tak jari rehta hai.
questions.hint: Yeh 5 ka table hai.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
questions.explanation: Har number apne se pehlay wale ka double hai, is liye 24 ka double 48 hai.
questions.hint: Har term ko usi miqdar se guna kiya jata hai.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 1, 4, 9, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Yeh perfect squares hain: 1², 2², 3², 4², is liye agla 5² = 25 hai.
questions.hint: 1, 2, 3, 4 ko square karke dekhiye.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ?
questions.explanation: Har number apne se pehlay do numbers ka majmua (Fibonacci-style) hai: 8 + 13 = 21.
questions.hint: Pichlay do numbers ko jama karein.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
questions.explanation: Yeh Fibonacci sequence hai, jahan har term pichlay do ka majmua hota hai: 5 + 8 = 13.
questions.hint: Yeh aik mashhoor sequence hai jo aik Italian mathematician ke naam par hai.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Farq har baar 2 se barhta hai (4,6,8,10,12), is liye agla term 30 + 12 = 42 hai.
questions.hint: Har jorray ke darmiyan farq dekhiye.

questions.question: Agla number kya hoga: 3, 7, 16, 35, 74, ?
questions.explanation: Har term taqreeban pichlay ka double hai plus barhta hua izafa: 74×2 + 5 = 153.
questions.hint: Har number ko double karke dekhiye kitna bacha.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: Circle, Square, Circle, Square, ?
questions.explanation: Pattern Circle aur Square ke darmiyan badalta rehta hai, is liye yeh Circle se dobara shuru hota hai.
questions.hint: Pattern har do shapes ke baad dohraya jata hai.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: A, B, A, B, A, ?
questions.explanation: Pattern sirf A aur B ke darmiyan badalta hai, is liye agla B hai.
questions.hint: Yeh do harfon ka simple dohraav hai.

questions.question: Letter pattern mukammal karein: A, C, E, G, ?
questions.explanation: Har letter alphabet mein aik harf chhorta hai (A, chhoro B, C, chhoro D, E...), aakhir mein I par jata hai.
questions.hint: Har baar do harf aagay ginain.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Har number pichlay ka double hai, is liye 16 ka double 32 hai.
questions.hint: Har term ko 2 se guna kiya jata hai.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: Z, Y, X, W, ?
questions.explanation: Pattern alphabet mein ulta (backward) aik harf aagay barhta hai, is liye W ke baad V aata hai.
questions.hint: Alphabet ko ulta soachiye.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: 1A, 2B, 3C, 4D, ?
questions.explanation: Number 1 se barhta hai aur letter alphabet mein aik qadam aagay barhta hai, jis se 5E milta hai.
questions.hint: Number aur letter ko alag alag track karein.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: Pehla letter aagay barhta hai (A,B,C,D,E) jabke dusra letter ulta (Z,Y,X,W,V) jata hai, jis se EV milta hai.
questions.hint: Do alphabets aik hi waqt mein mukhalif simton mein chal rahay hain.

questions.question: Pattern mukammal karein: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?
questions.explanation: Yeh sequence prime numbers ko tarteeb se list karta hai, aur 13 ke baad agla prime 17 hai.
questions.hint: Yeh numbers sirf 1 aur khud se taqseem hotay hain.

questions.question: Kaunsa cheez alag hai (odd one out): Apple, Banana, Carrot, Orange
questions.explanation: Carrot aik sabzi hai, jabke Apple, Banana, aur Orange sab phal hain.
questions.hint: In mein se teen darakhton ya bailon par phal ki tarah ugtay hain.

questions.question: Kaunsa cheez alag hai (odd one out): Dog, Cat, Table, Bird
questions.explanation: Table aik cheez (object) hai, jabke Dog, Cat, aur Bird sab zinda janwar hain.
questions.hint: In mein se teen khud harkat kar saktay hain.

questions.question: Kaunsa cheez alag hai (odd one out): Square, Triangle, Circle, Cube
questions.explanation: Cube aik 3D shape hai, jabke Square, Triangle, aur Circle sab flat 2D shapes hain.
questions.hint: In mein se teen ko kaghaz par bilkul flat banaya ja sakta hai.

questions.question: Kaunsa number alag hai (odd one out) in mein se: 3, 5, 9, 7, 11
questions.explanation: 9 prime number nahi hai (3×3=9), jabke 3, 5, 7, aur 11 sab prime hain.
questions.hint: Us number ko dhoondhen jiske do se zyada factors hain.

questions.question: Kaunsa cheez alag hai (odd one out): Paris, London, Berlin, Sahara
questions.explanation: Sahara aik registan (desert) hai, jabke Paris, London, aur Berlin sab darul hakoomat shehar hain.
questions.hint: In mein se teen jaghon par aap mayor dhoondh saktay hain.

questions.question: Kaunsa number alag hai (odd one out) in mein se: 16, 25, 36, 40, 49
questions.explanation: 40 perfect square nahi hai, jabke 16 (4²), 25 (5²), 36 (6²), aur 49 (7²) sab perfect squares hain.
questions.hint: Har number ka square root nikalne ki koshish karein.

questions.question: Kaunsa cheez alag hai (odd one out) in mein se: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Pluto, Mars
questions.explanation: Pluto ko 2006 mein dwarf planet qarar diya gaya, jabke baqi sab mukammal sayare hain.
questions.hint: In mein se aik ne apna 'planet' status kho diya.

questions.question: Kaunsa cheez alag hai (odd one out): Oxygen, Nitrogen, Helium, Water
questions.explanation: Water hydrogen aur oxygen se milkar bana compound hai, jabke baqi sab akaila (single) elements hain.
questions.hint: In mein se teen ko saada mawaad mein tor nahi jaa sakta.

questions.question: Agar tamam billiyan (cats) janwar hain, aur Whiskers aik billi hai, to Whiskers kya hai?
questions.explanation: Chunke tamam billiyan janwar hain aur Whiskers aik billi hai, is liye Whiskers zaroor janwar hoga.
questions.hint: Billi se janwar tak ke logical silsilay ko follow karein.

questions.question: Tom, Sam se lamba hai. Sam, Alex se lamba hai. Sabse chota kaun hai?
questions.explanation: Chunke Tom > Sam > Alex qad mein, is liye Alex teenon mein sabse chota hoga.
questions.hint: Inhein sabse lambay se sabse chotay tak tarteeb dein.

questions.question: Agar barish hoti hai to zameen geeli ho jati hai. Zameen geeli hai. Konsa nateeja durust hoga?
options: Barish hui hogi, ya kisi aur cheez ne geela kiya hoga
questions.explanation: Geeli zameen yeh sabit nahi karti ke barish hui — pipe ya kisi cheez ke gir jane se bhi aisa ho sakta hai. Sirf 'barish hui ya kuch aur' hi mehfooz nateeja hai.
questions.hint: Geeli zameen ki aik se zyada wajah ho sakti hain.

questions.question: Tamam squares rectangles hote hain. Yeh shakal rectangle nahi hai. Aap kya nateeja nikal saktay hain?
questions.explanation: Chunke har square aik rectangle hota hai, is liye jo cheez rectangle nahi woh square bhi nahi ho sakti.
questions.hint: Sochiye 'tamam squares rectangles hain' kya khaarij karta hai.

questions.question: Anna, Ben se pehlay finish karti hai. Ben, Cara se pehlay finish karta hai. Cara, Dan se pehlay finish karti hai. Ellen, Anna se pehlay finish karti hai. Sabse aakhir mein kaun finish karta hai?
questions.explanation: Finishing order hai: Ellen, Anna, Ben, Cara, Dan — is liye Dan sabse aakhir mein finish karta hai.
questions.hint: Tamam 'pehlay' clues ko jorkar aik hi tarteeb banayein.

questions.question: Sirf members hi club mein dakhil ho saktay hain. Sam club mein dakhil hua. Kya baat sach honi chahiye?
questions.explanation: Chunke sirf members hi dakhil ho saktay hain, aur Sam dakhil hua, is liye Sam zaroor member hoga.
questions.hint: Qaida sirf aik qisam ke insan ko darwazay se guzarne deta hai.

questions.question: Teen dabbon par 'Apples', 'Oranges', aur 'Mixed' likha hai — magar har label ghalat hai. Aap sirf aik dabbay se aik phal nikal kar tamam teenon ko sahih label kar saktay hain. Kis dabbay se nikalna chahiye?
questions.explanation: Chunke har label ghalat hai, is liye 'Mixed' likha dabba asal mein sirf aik hi phal ki qisam rakhta hoga, jo tamam teenon ka asal mawaad zahir kar dega.
questions.hint: Woh dabba jo mufeed tareeqay se zaroor ghalat hai woh 'Mixed' wala hai.

questions.question: Aik jazeeray par knights hamesha sach boltay hain aur knaves hamesha jhoot boltay hain. A kehta hai: 'B knave hai.' B kehta hai: 'A aur mein dono knights hain.' A aur B kya hain?
options: A knight hai, B knave hai
A knave hai, B knight hai
questions.explanation: Agar A knight hai, to A ka dawa ke B knave hai sach hoga — aur B ka jhoota dawa knave hone se match karta hai. Yehi wahid mustaqil (consistent) hal hai.
questions.hint: A aur B ke liye har knight/knave combination ko test karein jab tak baatein aik dosray se na takrayein.

questions.question: Agar aapke paas 3 seb hain aur aap 5 aur khareedtay hain, to aapke paas kitne hain?
questions.explanation: 3 + 5 = 8 seb total.
questions.hint: Simple jama (addition).

questions.question: 50 ka aadha (half) kya hai?
questions.explanation: 50 ka aadha 25 hai, kyunke 25 + 25 = 50.
questions.hint: 2 se taqseem karein.

questions.question: Aik shirt ki qeemat $40 hai. Isay 25% discount par sale kiya ja raha hai. Sale price kya hoga?
questions.explanation: $40 ka 25% $10 hai, is liye sale price $40 − $10 = $30 hai.
questions.hint: Pehlay $40 ka 25% nikalein, phir usay minus karein.

questions.question: Aik train 1 ghantay mein 60 miles safar karti hai. Usi raftaar par 3 ghanton mein woh kitna safar karegi?
questions.explanation: 60 miles per hour par, 3 ghanton mein train 60 × 3 = 180 miles tay karti hai.
questions.hint: Raftaar ko ghanton ki tadad se guna karein.

questions.question: Aik rectangle ki lambai 12 aur chorai 5 hai. Iska area kya hai?
questions.explanation: Area = length × width = 12 × 5 = 60.
questions.hint: Dono sides ko aapas mein guna karein.

questions.question: Agar 3x + 5 = 20, to x kya hai?
questions.explanation: Dono taraf se 5 minus karne par 3x = 15 milta hai, is liye x = 5.
questions.hint: Pehlay jama phir zarb ko ulta karke x ko alag karein.

questions.question: Aik gaari (car) har saal apni maujooda qeemat ka 10% kam ho jati hai (depreciation). Agar iski shuruati qeemat $20,000 hai, to 2 saal baad iski qeemat kya hogi (qareeb tareen dollar tak)?
questions.hint: 10% kami ko do martaba lagayein, sirf aik martaba nahi.

questions.question: Teen mutasil (consecutive) integers ka majmua 84 hai. In mein sabse bara number kya hai?
questions.explanation: Yeh integers 27, 28, aur 29 hain, kyunke 27 + 28 + 29 = 84, is liye sabse bara 29 hai.
questions.hint: Maan lijiye beech wala number n hai, to teen numbers n-1, n, n+1 hongay.
